## Just wear your privacy

## For your autonomy

It's all about you and your autonomy: whether it's tracking , AI , or unwanted photography, here you'll find styles and accessories for your personal privacy needs.

## Manufactured in the EU

We only offer fairly manufactured and high-quality products, so you can enjoy our designs for as long as possible. We cooperate with small businesses in Germany and the EU. There’s no Fast Fashion here!

## Innovative design

We put a lot of passion and effort into our designs. We develop and improve everything ourselves. This gives you the best possible combination of style and function and has earned us several nominations already.

## High-quality materials

We want you to feel that special something . We achieve this through a high standard of quality and the use of special high-tech materials .

## the style for your digital freedom

The only person who should have control over your privacy is you. Getting you there is our goal. And fashion is the perfect means to achieve it. It combines identity, conviction, statement, function and privacy in one. In fact, everything that is needed to raise awareness of this issue and at the same time be part of the solution.

## FAQ

The pattern on the shirt is designed with key features that facial recognition algorithms look for: eye spacing, contrast gradients, pixel grids. These visual cues trick machines into identifying the abstract print as a face – even though it looks like digital art to the human eye. A clever hack against digital surveillance.

We have put together various styles and accessories for your privacy needs. Some of our designs protect you directly by interrupting data streams. With our OFLAIN smartphone bag, you have the choice to go off the grid at any time. Others, such as our QR code scarf, communicate playfully that you don't want to be photographed without being asked. With our Statement T-shirt , you can easily make a statement and help to make privacy and data protection more important. In the end, you are not only protecting yourself, but others too.

It is important to us that the products are of high quality , last a long time and that the people who make them are treated fairly . That's why we mainly work with smaller companies from Germany and Europe . We value the direct relationship with our cooperation partners, who share our love of detail. We only produce small runs of our products, so we do not have large quantities of stock. Fast fashion is not an option for us. This can sometimes result in waiting times.

We only use carefully selected materials so you can enjoy your regained privacy for as long as possible. Wherever possible, we use fabrics and materials from European sources.

For our clothing, we pay attention to environmentally friendly production. We use high-tech materials for our technical products, such as the OFLAIN smartphone bag , to ensure that they meet our high quality standards.
